sections.sectionTitle: Papers 1 & 2: General Knowledge in Art & Art History

subtopics.content: Elements and principles of design, perspective types (linear, aerial, foreshortening), care and maintenance of art tools/materials, art terminology, and inter-relationships of the visual and performing arts
subtopics.objective: Identify and apply art elements and principles in visual compositions[cite: 586]; differentiate perspective techniques[cite: 586]; manage and maintain art equipment[cite: 586]; define standard art terms[cite: 586]; explain the inter-relationships among visual, performing, and literary arts[cite: 586].

subtopics.content: Ancient traditional West African art (Nok, Ife, Benin, Igbo-Ukwu, Senufo, Dogon, Ashanti, etc.), modern traditional art/crafts (Kente, Adinkra, Osogbo art, Bida brass, pottery), contemporary art institutions/movements, cultural festivals, and prominent West African artists
subtopics.objective: Analyze ancient West African sculptures, masks, and indigenous art forms[cite: 586, 587]; evaluate modern traditional art forms, crafts, and decorative motifs[cite: 587]; examine the role of art institutions, festivals, and major West African contemporary artists[cite: 587].

topics.title: Pre-historic, Ancient Egyptian, and Western Art

subtopics.content: Pre-historic art (Stone Ages), Ancient Egyptian art (Old, Middle, New Kingdoms), Greek art periods, Medieval art, 19th-century movements (Impressionism, Post-Impressionism), Renaissance art, and 20th-century Cubism (African art influences)
subtopics.objective: Trace historical developments, stylistic features, and cultural contexts of Pre-historic, Egyptian, Greek, Medieval, Renaissance, 19th-century, and 20th-century Western art movements[cite: 587].

topics.title: Drawing, 2-Dimensional Creative Design, and 3-Dimensional Creative Design

subtopics.content: Part A: Drawing from objects, nature, or life. Part B (2D): Graphic design (lettering, posters, book illustration, printmaking, packaging, computer graphics), textile design (batik, tie-dye, screen printing, appliqué, tapestry), picture-making (painting/mural, photography, mosaic, collage). Part C (3D): Sculpture, product modeling, ceramics, and traditional crafts (basketry, jewelry, calabash decoration)
subtopics.objective: Execute observational drawings from object groups, natural forms, or human models[cite: 588]; design two-dimensional projects across graphics, textiles, and picture-making[cite: 588, 589, 590]; produce three-dimensional artworks in sculpture, ceramics, product modeling, or traditional crafts accompanied by working drawings[cite: 590].
